original_test_intent: Verify that each Type 16 array reports the approved maximum addressable capacity using the correct SMBIOS legacy or extended representation, with correct units and consistency with the platform memory design, and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture full raw Type 16/17 records and SMBIOS version; bind capacity fields to array handles, apply the specified legacy sentinel and Extended Maximum Capacity precedence, normalize units with overflow-safe arithmetic, compare the design limit and linked inventory, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves each array's design limit and reboot plan. No DIMM population change is required to validate the declared maximum.
required_inputs: Expected maximum capacity per Type 16 array
Applicable SMBIOS version and legacy/extended field interpretation
Platform socket/channel/slot and per-device capacity limits
Policy distinguishing installed capacity from maximum supported capacity
Raw-capable dmidecode/parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and OS inventory; do not add, remove or overpopulate DIMMs.
Treat the defined legacy Maximum Capacity sentinel as a selector for Extended Maximum Capacity, not as a literal capacity.
Use unsigned overflow-safe unit conversion and preserve raw values/units.
Do not equate the sum of installed Type 17 sizes with the maximum supported capacity.
Stop on missing required extended field, conflicting representations or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse per-array raw legacy and extended capacity fields, apply version-aware precedence, normalize values, compare the approved design and pre/post reboot evidence.
Do not alter hardware/firmware, infer undocumented limits or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-array capacity limits, SMBIOS interpretation and platform topology assumptions.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded Maximum Capacity line is relevant, but grep -A1 loses the array handle, raw legacy value, SMBIOS version and potentially the separate Extended Maximum Capacity field.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/17 data and SMBIOS version; report per array the raw legacy value, sentinel decision, raw extended value, normalized bytes, design limit and installed linked capacity separately.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Maximum Capacity scope, Type 16 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Apply the SMBIOS-defined legacy sentinel/extended-field rules per Type 16 record, normalize capacity with checked arithmetic, compare the approved architectural maximum and retain installed Type 17 totals as a separate metric.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 16 records, especially arrays whose maximum exceeds the legacy encoding range.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser and OS inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16 Maximum Capacity and Extended Maximum Capacity field definitions and authoritative platform memory limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-field precedence, version gating, unit/overflow validation, record identity and separation of supported versus installed capacity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects sentinel misinterpretation, missing/illegal extended fields, unit overflow, wrong-array values and false comparisons to current population.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-array architectural limit and applicable SMBIOS semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct firmware-declared maximum does not prove unsupported DIMM combinations or electrical margins were physically qualified.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a lower validated population limit than the silicon/theoretical maximum, but must label which limit the testcase expects; current installed capacity must not silently replace either value.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, per-array capacity baseline, SMBIOS version and precedence/unit policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/17 records and SMBIOS entry-point/version evidence
Per-array raw legacy/sentinel/extended values, normalized capacity and checked conversion
Separate linked installed-capacity summary and design-limit comparison
Approved reboot/health evidence and complete post-reboot capacity diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Maximum Capacity has defined version-aware semantics; the neighboring Extended Maximum Capacity case is complementary rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding and comparison are automatable after expected limits and approved reboot inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds per-array identity, raw representation, sentinel/extended precedence, overflow-safe units and installed-versus-maximum separation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its version-aware safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes the legacy-field decision itself testable and keeps final verdict engineer-owned.

review_improvement: Prevents a decoded capacity from passing when it came from a misread sentinel, wrong units, wrong array or a conflation of supported and populated memory.
independent_technical_reasoning: Capacity decoding and topology arithmetic are deterministic structured-data operations; approved limits and reboot permission affect readiness, not automation capability.
